_doc: Equipment drops (spec #33, #109, #159). items: the eligible equipment, ids only (reqLevel, reqJob and stats are read from the canonical Character.wz info in the asset cache): every v83 Character.wz cap, coat, longcoat, pants, shoes, glove, shield (109xxxx) and weapon of a playable family that is not cash, has reqLevel 0-70 and reqJob 0 (armour only) or the job line's bit, and that a regular v83 server gave out: dropped by an ordinary mob (id 100000-7999999) in Cosmic's drop_data or sold by a regular NPC shop (Cosmic shopitems, shop id below 9000000, not 1337). This keeps quest, event, GM and boss-only items out (tier B: server data used as facts). Weapons and shields carry their line's bit, never reqJob 0, so a Beginner and a Magician see none of the Warrior weapons or shields. Only items whose reqJob allows the character's current job can drop, and a weapon only when it is of the family of the weapon held at the roll (EquipmentDrops). The item ids live in the per-line fragments equipment_drops/<line>.json (common = reqJob 0 armour, then one file per job line; its weapons and shields with their line: wands and staves with the Magician, swords, axes, blunt weapons, spears, polearms and Warrior shields with the Warrior), concatenated and sorted ascending by DataRepo.load_all; a duplicate id is an error (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4).
_rules: below/above: an item can drop when its reqLevel is within [level - below, level + above] (owner, tier C). falloff: weight = 1 / (1 + falloff x |reqLevel - level|), so nearer items are likelier (tier C). chance: per ordinary kill, sized once from an estimate (tier C): a full Henesys clear is about 3,300 kills and the ticket wants about 8-12 items a round including the boss drops, so about 7 ordinary drops is 0.002 per kill (v83 mobs gave equipment on 0.7-2% of kills, but a round has thousands of kills). boss_drops: items each scheduled boss death drops, no chance roll (tier C: the ticket says exactly one). boss_top: a boss item comes from reqLevel [level + above - boss_top, level + above] (the top of the window; the highest reqLevel in the window when nothing is that high; the nearest eligible item when the window is empty). shared_families: weapon families that drop for each other's holder (tier C: a Magician wields a wand or a staff, so a Magician holding either sees both, as before the weapon-family rule; every other family drops only for its own holder, bare hands get no weapon).
_shield_families: Tier C (#207): optional first-job id -> allowed held weapon families for shield drops, including descendants and boss fallback. Thief shields require a dagger; a claw occupies both hands. Unlisted lines have no held-family restriction.
